decisions.summary: each polder channel on 0068's ladder: feeder supply canal 4.5->1.5, toes and laterals delivery ditch 2.5->1.2, drain 1.2->5.5
decisions.why: 0068 places every stroke by the ground it waters; reading the toes as deliveries off the feeder is inside the row's own fix text

decisions.summary: every delivery head - the four laterals and both toes - capped at 0.8 of the feeder's local width where it leaves it, floored at the hamlet's 1.5 ft; Kuwabata east toe 1.5/1.5, west toe 1.5->2.5, laterals 2.5, 2.5, 2.4, 1.9
decisions.why: 0068 in those words; round 1's east-toe item answered - polder.py applies the cap to channels[1] at its first point and channels[3] at its last, and kuwabata.json field_ditches reads e_toe 1.5/1.5, w_toe 1.5/2.5 (m:wave73-polder-widths-r2)

decisions.summary: bank per channel: feeder 5 ft, toe 1.5 ft bund, drain half a bund (0.75 ft), lateral (8 ft corridor - the ditch where it is)/2
decisions.why: 0055 and 0022; the plan's Scope bullet now states each channel's own bank (round 1 item 3 answered)

decisions.summary: the band read at the ditch's half-width at each segment (_nearest_band); for a lateral the berm is computed from that same local width, so the band is 4 ft each side all along
decisions.why: 0055 'half the ditch's drawn width at that point' and 0022's 8 ft corridor; round 1's lateral-berm item answered - _plots_clear_of_channels passes the segment width to channel_berm for a lateral (wd/2 + (8 - wd)/2 = 4 ft), pinned by test_a_laterals_band_is_its_corridor_all_along

decisions.summary: _polder_channels#channel widths re-tiered E2 -> E3 on measure, open for the drain (and the stub/leg/notch lengths)
decisions.why: measured, not argued: the outfall taps the drain mid-run and the one-taper stroke cannot peak mid-run; the drain is read as one channel across comb.py, polder.py, sink.py and ring_rules.py - E3 by spec FR-003. The row stays DRIFTED and ranked. Its condition (the toes capped, so the remainder is the drain only) is now met, and the stale 'channel widths: E2' closed-tier entry is gone (round 1 item 4 answered)

decisions.summary: meanwhile the drain drawn at its 5.5 ft outfall width throughout
decisions.why: an interim on an open DRIFTED row, recorded at the code, the claim and the override; not claimed done
